# Fireberry

Fireberry is a CRM platform that offers integrations with various tools and applications to streamline business processes.

Category: Sales & CRM. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/fireberry/.

## Actions

- **Create a new Fireberry record**: Create a new record in a specified fireberry table.
- **Fireberry: Query Records** (read-only): Query records with filtering, sorting, and pagination.
- **Get Picklist Values** (read-only): Retrieve all possible picklist (dropdown) values for a specific field.
